classification: static numerical-contract diagnosis; not a performance score
finding: The exact-four-row activation buffer is produced by ggml_quantize_mat_t<8, GGML_TYPE_Q8_K> as interleaved block_q8_Kx4. The rejected v3 dispatch passed that same buffer to a GEMV that casts it to four contiguous block_q8_K rows. Separate accumulator specializations do not repair this incompatible memory layout, so v4 was stopped before compilation.

produced_type.layout: four deltas followed by interleaved quants and interleaved bsums

claim_boundary: This source-level diagnosis explains the v3 failure and rejects v4's accumulator-only remedy. It is not runtime correctness, speed, quality, or novelty evidence.
